newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: UBP says 96 gains from greater efficiency.
newsitem.headline: UBP says 96 gains from greater efficiency.

text.p: Union Bank of the Philippines (UBP) said on Tuesday its improved financial performance last year was due to bank's increased efficiency.
The bank earlier reported an unaudited net profit of 961.8 million pesos for 1996, 32 percent higher than its 729 million pesos earnings in 1995.
The bank said its cost-to-income ratio went down to 53 percent in 1996 from 61 percent the previous year.

"Union Bank's performance is a continuing result of its core strategy of serving its customers well through more product choices, shorter service times, expert financial advice and a solutions-oriented approach to customer relationships," the bank said in a statement.
The bank said its total resources grew by 50 percent to 49.2 billion pesos as of end-1996 from 32.7 billion pesos in end-1995.
Total loans increased by 55 percent to 27.6 billion pesos while total deposits grew by 44 percent to 20.6 billion pesos.
